title: SARS-CoV-2 Tailed Amplicon Illumina Sequencing
author: Daryl Gohl
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bipikdke
materials: Thaw RNA samples on ice then transfer 5 µL of sample into a 96-well Thermo PCR plate.
For each sample, combine 10 µL of each of the four pools in a single Bio-Rad fully-skirted 96 well plate.
In a 96-well Thermo plate, add 2 µL of each sample to 198 µL of nuclease free water (1:100 dilution).

steps.title: Prepare Workspace and Samples
steps.instruction: Clean the workspace and pipets using RNaseZAP or a comparable product (e.g., RNase Away) and wipe down with KimWipes. Ensure RNA samples are stored at -80 °C and thawed on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Reverse Transcription Master Mix
steps.instruction: Set up the reverse transcription reaction master mix, multiplying volumes by the number of reactions plus desired overage.

substeps.instruction: Add 11 µL nuclease free water
Add 4 µL SuperScript IV VILO master mix

steps.title: Perform Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Execute the reverse transcription reaction in a sample containing well plate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 15 µL of reverse transcription master mix to each sample containing well
Seal plate with a “B” seal
Vortex using a plate vortexer at 1900 rpm for 10 seconds
Spin down in a plate centrifuge for 5 seconds at 2500 rpm
Incubate in a thermocycler: 25 °C for 10 minutes, 50 °C for 10 minutes, and 85 °C for 5 minutes

steps.title: Prepare PCR 1 Plates
steps.instruction: Distribute cDNA into four 96-well Thermo PCR plates labeled Project_Name_PCR1_1.1, Project_Name_PCR1_1.2, Project_Name_PCR1_2.1, and Project_Name_PCR1_2.2.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 2.5 µL of cDNA to each of the four plates

steps.title: Prepare PCR 1 Master Mixes
steps.instruction: Set up four PCR master mixes, one for each of the four multiplexed primer pools (1.1, 1.2, 2.1, or 2.2), multiplying volumes by the number of reactions plus desired overage.

substeps.instruction: Add 14.75 µL nuclease-free water
Add 5 µL 5x Q5 reaction buffer
Add 0.5 µL 10mM dNTPs
Add 0.25 µL Q5 Polymerase
Add 2 µL primer pool (10 µM)

steps.title: Amplify PCR 1
steps.instruction: Perform the first round of PCR amplification.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 22.5 µL of the appropriate master mix to each well of the corresponding PCR plate
Seal plate with a “B” seal
Vortex using a plate vortexer at 1900 rpm for 10 seconds
Spin down in a plate centrifuge for 5 seconds at 2500 rpm
Amplify using conditions: 98 °C for 30 seconds, then 35 cycles of (98 °C for 15 seconds, 65 °C for 5 minutes)

steps.title: Prepare Indexing PCR
steps.instruction: Set up the indexing PCR reaction in a 96-well Thermo PCR plate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 5 µL of 1:100 diluted PCR 1 sample to the plate
Transfer 2 µL of 5 µM indexing primer mix to the plate
Prepare PCR master mix (multiply by reactions + overage): 0.7 µL nuclease-free water, 2 µL 5x Q5 reaction buffer, 0.2 µL 10 mM dNTPs, and 0.1 µL Q5 Polymerase
Transfer 3 µL of master mix to each well
Seal plate with a “B” seal
Vortex using a plate vortexer at 1900 rpm for 10 seconds
Spin down in a plate centrifuge for 5 seconds at 2500 rpm
Amplify using conditions: 98 °C for 30 seconds, then 10 cycles of (98 °C for 20 seconds, 55 °C for 15 seconds, 72 °C for 1 minute), followed by a final 72 °C for 5 minutes

steps.title: Normalize and Elute Samples
steps.instruction: Normalize samples and elute using the SequalPrep system.

substeps.instruction: Normalize samples using a SequalPrep plate according to manufacturer’s instructions (sequalprep_platekit_man.pdf)
Elute in 20 µL of SequalPrep Elution Buffer

steps.title: Pool and Purify Library
steps.instruction: Pool the normalized samples and perform final purification.

substeps.instruction: Pool 10 µL of each sample in a trough, mix well, and transfer to a 1.5 mL non-stick tube
Purify using AMPureXP beads at a 0.7x ratio
Elute library in 20 µL of EB

steps.title: Final QC and MiSeq Loading
steps.instruction: Perform quality control and prepare the library for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Determine concentration using PicoGreen or Qubit assay
Prepare 2 nM pool dilution based on concentration and expected fragment size (~555 bp)
Dilute pooled sample to 8 pM in HT1 following MiSeq loading instructions
Spike in 5% 8 pM PhiX
Load into MiSeq 2x250 or 2x300 reagent cartridge
